Plants of the World Online account: Senna polyphylla (Jacq.) H.S.Irwin & Barneby.

The native range of this species is Mexico to Honduras, Caribbean to Venezuela, E. Brazil. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.
